spans.s:
After the verb विश् 'to enter', when preceded by the preposition नि, the आत्मनेपद affixes are employed

Terms: आत्मनेपद

The affixes बिडच् and बिरीसच् come in the sense of 'a hooked nose' after the word नि when the word so formed is a Name.

Terms: बिडच् and बिरीसच्

After नि the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable when the sense is of 'not laying down'.

Terms:

The ण is the substitute of न् of the prefix नि , following a cause for such change standing in an उपसर्ग when these words follow - गद 'to speak', नद 'to be happy', पत 'to fall', पद 'to go'; the घु verbs - मा 'to measure', शो 'to destroy', हन् 'to kill', या 'to go', वा 'to blow', द्रा 'to flee', प्शा 'to eat', वप् 'to weave', वह् 'to bear', शम् 'to be tranquil', चि 'to collect', and दिह् 'to anoint'.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-तिङ्-उपसर्ग
